description: AI governance refers to the frameworks, policies, principles, and processes organizations and societies establish to ensure artificial intelligence systems are developed and used responsibly, ethically, and in alignment with human values and legal requirements.
external_context: AI governance covers areas such as transparency, accountability, fairness, privacy, safety, and human oversight. It is commonly used to guide compliance with emerging regulations like the EU AI Act and to build trust by establishing risk management and audit practices. Related concepts include AI ethics, AI safety, and AI risk management.
